subject: Academic Department Budget Priorities
overview: The committee reviewed FY2022 budget requests and priorities for humanities, science, world languages, fine arts, and health/PE, focusing on pandemic recovery and learning interventions. The committee voted to accept the superintendent's draft recommendations for inclusion in the budget for final review.

items.title: Budget Process and Funding Overview
items.summary: The administration reviewed the FY2022 budget timeline and the strategic integration of federal ESSER pandemic relief funds to address instructional disruptions.

items.title: Humanities Budget Priorities
items.summary: Humanities priorities included restoring middle school reading specialists, implementing early literacy screening tools, and adopting new student assessments for grades 3 through 11.

items.title: Science Department Requests
items.summary: Science requests focused on replenishing FOSS kit consumables, procuring anatomy and physiology textbooks, and maintaining digital resource licenses like Newsela.

items.title: World Languages and Fine Arts Priorities
items.summary: Plans included introducing French in sixth grade, updating middle school textbooks, and expanding the instrument inventory for guitars and ukuleles.

items.title: Health and Physical Education Priorities
items.summary: Requests featured the addition of a district-wide adaptive PE teacher and a dedicated middle school health teacher to alleviate counselor workloads.

items.title: Literacy Curriculum and Intervention Discussion
items.summary: The committee discussed the potential GLEAM grant to expedite the replacement of the 'Journeys' reading program and the necessity of targeted reading specialists at the high school level.

items.title: Fine Arts and Music Recovery
items.summary: Members expressed concerns regarding the impact of the pandemic on elementary string programs and emphasized the need for consistent transportation funding for fine arts similar to athletics.

items.title: Approval of Draft Recommendations
items.summary: The committee approved a motion to accept the superintendent's draft recommendations across all presented academic categories for final review.

items.title: Scheduling of Future Budget Hearings
items.summary: The body discussed the statutory requirements for budget hearings and directed the administration to schedule a formal public hearing for later in May.
